# Current law — meta-governance

**GENERATED by `pnpm governance:compile`. Never hand-edit (RULING 92).**
Governance snapshot `411dbe6d8f729e54`. 7 rule(s) in force.

This file carries CURRENT law for this domain and nothing else. Superseded
wording is not here — it is in `docs/governance/history.md`, which explains
and never governs (RULING 172).

Authority precedence is RULING 185. The root constitution is `CLAUDE.md`.

## RULING 230 — one canonical model-switch verdict

*`R-0230` · ACTIVE · author_explicit · 2026-09-01 · also cited as `RULING 230`, `R230`, `R-230`*

- **related_to** → `R-0185`
- **related_to** → `R-0180`
- **related_to** → `R-0189`
- **related_to** → `R-0103`
- **sets** `model.switch_rule` = `every-required-question-measured-and-held`
- **sets** `model.verdict_emitters` = `exactly-one-canonical-emitter`

**SWITCH only if EVERY required challenger question is measured AND holds.
Any required question measured and not held is HOLD/RETAIN. Any required
question unmeasured is NOT_MEASURED, and the incumbent is retained. NO SECOND
FUNCTION MAY EMIT A SwitchVerdict.**

## The contradiction this retires

One comparison record carried both of these at once:

```
  decision            RETAIN:claude-opus-5
  ownerCriterionMet   false
  verdict.kind        SWITCH
```

The cause was not a bug. `switchVerdict` implemented a RELATIVE non-regression
rule — a challenger question blocks the switch only where the INCUMBENT held it
and the challenger did not — and that rule was argued, tested and deliberate.
On the 2026-08-31 measurement two of the questions that reached the synthesis
contract failed on BOTH arms for the SAME reason. Nothing degraded, so the
relative rule derived SWITCH. Nothing like "every question holds" was true, so
the author's criterion derived RETAIN. The test suite then PRESERVED the
disagreement, which made a contradiction into a fixture.

## Why the absolute rule wins, and why representing the conflict is not enough

RULING 185 puts an explicit current author directive at precedence 1 and a
prior implementation decision below it. Representing a conflict is the right
move while it is a conflict; it is the wrong move once the author has decided.
A machine-readable field that disagrees with the human decision beside it is
not a represented conflict — it is **two answers with no rule for which one a
later session reads**, and a later session reading the wrong one switches the
model that answers a reader's question about their own government.

## What survives

The relative analysis is not deleted and its reasoning is not withdrawn: *a
question neither model answers is a retrieval gap, and holding the model choice
hostage to it would make every future switch impossible for a reason unrelated
to the model.* That remains TRUE and remains USEFUL. It survives as a
DIAGNOSTIC under a name that cannot be mistaken for a verdict —
`relativeNonRegressionAnalysis` — and it returns its own type. **It may not
return a SwitchVerdict.** Exactly one function in the repository emits that
type, and it implements the rule above.

## The comparison seam stays out of production

The route emits the challenger model only through the comparison harness. There
is no per-request model switching in the production Ask route, and comparison
caches stay disabled or isolated so measured costs are an upper bound. That is
asserted rather than assumed.

## What a failing question means

A question that fails identically on both arms is evidence about the PRODUCT,
not about either model, and it belongs on the frontier under its own name. The
2026-08-31 Q5 failure is exactly that: an 18-record pack cannot fit the ASK-19
700-character budget. Recording it as a model result would have hidden a budget
defect behind a model decision.

## RULING 247 — THE CONSOLIDATION

*`R-0247` · ACTIVE · author_explicit · 2026-09-03 · also cited as `RULING 247`, `R247`, `R-247`*

**On 2026-09-03 the author found the governance corpus unreadable in operation: 283 ledger records, 251 active, roughly half a megabyte of rationale, and the same principle restated for every incident that had ever illustrated it. He ordered it rewritten. This ruling is that rewrite.**

- Every consolidated ruling names the rulings it absorbs. Those rulings become `SUPERSEDED` and stay in the ledger and in history with their full text, per RULING 272. Their numbers are never reused.
- A consolidated ruling changes no obligation, bar, or proof standard. Where a reader believes it does, that belief is treated as a conservation failure, not a reading: the consolidated criterion is NOT MET until the missing clause is restored to the policy through the ledger or the current rule is amended. Base authority governs until the restoration lands. History explains a rule; it never overrides the current one.
- A record that was a rule in substance is absorbed whatever its recorded kind. A record that is a one-day call, a measurement, an acceptance or a tombstone is not consolidated and stays as it was; `current-decisions.md` lists the calls still in force.
- **Law is written once, in the policy that owns it, as a rule with its clauses. Rationale lives in history. A new ruling that restates an existing rule for a new incident is refused by the governance validator as a duplicate and is recorded as a history note against the rule it illustrates.**
- Two hand-written copies of any rule may never exist again. `CLAUDE.md` carries the cross-cutting one-line form and cites the ruling; the policy carries the rule; nothing carries both.

- **sets** `rulings.id_namespace` = `global-immutable`
- **sets** `governance.amendment_procedure` = `canonical-ledger-and-generated-views`
- **sets** `status.claim_standard` = `generated-with-proving-check`

**The canonical store is `docs/governance/ledger.jsonl`. Everything else — `CLAUDE.md`'s policy index, every policy, the autonomous-system constitution, `rulings.md`, `history.md`, `current-decisions.md` — is a view of it, regenerated by `pnpm governance:compile` and checked by `pnpm governance:check`. A generated artifact is never hand-edited; the generator is fixed and the artifact regenerated and diffed, and a generator whose digest moved fails the build until its output is regenerated.**

- **Authority precedence, one model:** (1) explicit current author directive; (2) `CLAUDE.md`; (3) the delegated current policy; (4) active non-law author decisions; (5) the session brief; (6) operational state and measurements; (7) history. History explains; history never overrides. A brief that conflicts with current law does not silently win unless it is an explicit author amendment — the conflict is represented, not resolved by whichever document was read last.
- **Binding authority requires author provenance.** Only `author_explicit` or `author_confirmed` may create law or decision state. A session's reading is recorded as a reading; a measurement is recorded as a fact; neither becomes the rule by being written confidently.
- **Amendment.** A ruling changes only by a later-dated ruling that names the number it supersedes and states what changed and what survives — structured relations, never a boolean. Rulings are never edited in place, never silently dropped; a superseded ruling stays in the record marked superseded. Numbers are global, immutable, never reused.
- **A governance change is atomic.** The ledger event, the operative policy, the regenerated views, the regenerated startup context and a passing `governance:check` land together or the change has not happened.
- **A session opens on task-relevant current authority** (`pnpm governance:open --task <domain>`), never on the full history. Anything a session must read at the start lives in the repository; a file the author places in the repo is registered into git unread, and the fence on its content stands. No generated file has a size limit.
- **Status is generated, never asserted.** A status claim names the gate or test that fails when it stops being true, with timestamp and SHA. One canonical verdict function per decision class — a model switch, for instance, is SWITCH only if every required question is measured and holds, and no second function may emit a verdict.
- **More principles will not fix behaviour.** What changes behaviour is a required output that cannot be produced by walking a list, and an instrument that refuses. A rule without an instrument is guidance.

## RULING 273 — how a session runs

*`R-0273` · ACTIVE · author_explicit · 2026-09-03 · also cited as `RULING 273`, `R273`, `R-273`*

- **related_to** → `R-0146`
- **supersedes_full** → `R-0158`
- **supersedes_full** → `R-0180`
- **supersedes_full** → `R-0187`
- **supersedes_full** → `R-0188`
- **supersedes_full** → `R-0189`
- **supersedes_full** → `R-0190`
- **related_to** → `R-0191`
- **supersedes_full** → `R-0194`
- **supersedes_full** → `R-0221`
- **supersedes_full** → `R-0223`
- **supersedes_full** → `R-0225`
- **supersedes_full** → `R-0228`
- **supersedes_full** → `R-0237`
- **supersedes_full** → `R-0244`
- **supersedes_full** → `R-C-the-order-of-every-trade-correct-first-fast-second-nothing-third`
- **sets** `session.stop_standard` = `work-author-or-external-condition`
- **sets** `session.orchestration_model` = `independent-work-parallel-by-default`
- **sets** `orchestration.denominator` = `declared-logical-workstreams-reconciled`
- **sets** `session.completion_denominator` = `finite-stated-at-start`
- **sets** `session.discovered_defect_routing` = `frontier-unless-falsifies-or-regresses`
- **sets** `session.human_gated_status` = `needs-owner-terminal-not-open-executable`
- **sets** `session.discretion_scope` = `implementation-and-ordering-never-the-contract`
- **sets** `session.capacity_end_output` = `unfinished-session-with-resume-point-and-named-items`
- **sets** `report.lead_order` = `reader-then-unattended-then-owner-then-infrastructure`
- **sets** `interface.definition_form` = `one-shared-typed-schema-both-sides-validate`
- **sets** `interface.compatibility_evidence` = `real-producer-output-into-real-consumer`
- **sets** `session.efficiency_law` = `adopted-verbatim`
- **sets** `worker.efficiency_law` = `adopted-verbatim`

**Correct first. Fast second. Nothing third.** A fast wrong answer is a false claim about a government, the one failure this product cannot survive. Never ship partial data as complete, never let green stand in for verified, never trade an honest gap for a plausible guess.

**The rule, entire:**
```
DO THE WORK THAT WAS ASKED FOR.
KEEP WORKING WHILE AUTHORIZED EXECUTABLE WORK REMAINS.
STOP WHEN THE REQUESTED WORK IS ACTUALLY COMPLETE, WHEN THE AUTHOR EXPLICITLY
STOPS OR REDIRECTS THE SESSION, OR WHEN THE ENVIRONMENT ITSELF ACTUALLY
PREVENTS CONTINUATION.
```

- **The denominator is finite and stated at the start.** A discovered defect joins the denominator only if it falsifies a stated acceptance criterion or is the session's own regression; everything else is recorded on the frontier with evidence and left. `NEEDS_SEAN` is terminal for the session's denominator and never counts as open executable work. Discretion covers how, never what: "I chose depth over coverage" is an unrecorded amendment to the brief, not a stop.
- **A session does not measure itself.** No context percentage, no threshold, no proxy for one — not minutes, tokens, messages, commits or fatigue. Five statuses: `COMPLETE`, `CLEAN_HANDOFF_AUTHOR_STOP`, `CLEAN_HANDOFF_EXTERNAL_STOP`, `EARLY_HANDOFF`, `FAILED_CLOSEOUT`. Every non-complete close records a specific `stop_reason` and `executable_owed_work_remaining`, derived from canonical state by `pnpm workstream:close`, never asserted. An external stop is never inferred; one blocked item never qualifies while other work exists. Session, workstream and graph status are three independent facts. When capacity actually ends, the only lawful output is UNFINISHED SESSION with the exact resume point and every unreached item by name — and that is not a failure.
- **A session is an engineering organization.** When two or more authorized workstreams are materially independent, parallel execution is the default and serializing them is a defect that must name the dependency. Every workstream created after start receives a canonical id and is appended to the plan before it begins; a branch is never the denominator. Any interface between independently built lanes is one shared typed schema imported by both sides and proven by a compatibility test that runs the real producer into the real consumer; a paragraph is not a contract.
- **Every session report leads in reader terms:** what a reader can now see that they could not before; what workers advanced unattended; what genuinely requires the owner. Infrastructure counts come afterward. If a reader would see what they saw yesterday, it is not the lead.
- **The Session Efficiency Law (`docs/governance/session-efficiency.md`) and the Worker Efficiency Law bind every session and every worker** — parallelism follows independence, verification fan-out has diminishing returns, the proof is designed before the implementation, cache the stable prefix, route each step to the cheapest adequate model, never re-walk a recorded rung, and never lower a proof bar to save a token.
- **The descent freezes only for the minimum safe state cutover.** Never freeze the product until every historical document is perfect.
- Section edits to `docs/state.md` insert; they never replace, so previously recorded state is never overwritten.
- A tracker row is a record of work, never a substitute for it: if an item is executable now, it is executed now, not filed for later, and a created row is never reported as work completion.
- Persisted resumability is not permission to stop voluntarily: canonical resumable state exists so an interrupted session can resume, not so this one may end.

## RULING 274 — an instrument proves what it claims

*`R-0274` · ACTIVE · author_explicit · 2026-09-03 · also cited as `RULING 274`, `R274`, `R-274`*

- **supersedes_full** → `R-0005`
- **supersedes_full** → `R-0024`
- **supersedes_full** → `R-0062`
- **supersedes_full** → `R-0116`
- **supersedes_full** → `R-0147`
- **supersedes_full** → `R-0157`
- **supersedes_full** → `R-0159`
- **supersedes_full** → `R-0193`
- **sets** `guard.evidence_standard` = `checked-evidence-only`

**No layer certifies itself, including the audit layer.** A guard may pin an invariant or a direction, never the size of a gap — a test that freezes how much work is left goes red when the work gets done. A counting script fails loudly on a zero denominator. A check that cannot run says so and is counted. A reconciliation names its external anchor. A fix is verified against a case it was not derived from. `walk:all` never taps a reaction; a suite that manufactured signal in the sold store every run would be worse than no suite. The adversarial auditor starts from the publisher, the canonical identity and the vault — never from the original worker's summary — and the auditor is itself scored by the control set: its catch rate on planted defects is reported beside its findings.
- **A denominator is not a membership proof.** Cardinality is a diagnostic, not an identity: two sets of equal size are not the same set, and a gate that cannot NAME the elements it compared has not compared them.

## RULING 275 — data conventions that bind everywhere

*`R-0275` · ACTIVE · author_explicit · 2026-09-03 · also cited as `RULING 275`, `R275`, `R-275`*

- **supersedes_full** → `R-0006`
- **supersedes_full** → `R-0009`
- **supersedes_full** → `R-0010`
- **supersedes_full** → `R-0020`
- **supersedes_full** → `R-0045`
- **supersedes_full** → `R-0073`
- **supersedes_full** → `R-0080`
- **supersedes_full** → `R-0111`
- **supersedes_full** → `R-0117`
- **supersedes_full** → `R-0119`
- **related_to** → `R-0121`

- **OCD-ID is the authoritative internal key.** An address resolves to a district, the district is stamped on the row, the address is discarded.
- **Coverage tiers, verbatim everywhere:** Tier 0 roster only · Tier 1 territory resolved · Tier 2 bodies enumerated · Tier 3 Kelly depth. A tier is never inferred at read time and never raised by a session that did not do the work. Census and NCES establish Tiers 0 and 1; they never establish Tier 2.
- **The Kelly standard has no tiers:** every official and candidate carries a photo, a phone, a working contact, a specific verified page, and a campaign site.
- **A ZCTA is not a ZIP code**; state the mapping method. The committed TIGER geometry follows the reader, not the county: a unit this product names is a unit the map can draw.
- **A join is never a lookup for a fact that lives on one side.** Say which file holds the answer and whether the join can lose rows; if it can, ask the file. Identical payloads across distinct keys are presumed a collapse until proven distinct.
- **Portraits and PDF corpora do not go in git.** They live in the public content-addressed store (`github.com/SeanJ22/wtp-assets`), hashes committed, every restore proved by hash. Large reference documents commit the content, the SHA-256 and the provenance, never the binary.
- **The ripcord doctrine.** Legally open features ship behind a named kill switch; every record carries a provenance tag; ripcorded data never enters a sold aggregate until the question closes.
- **A sovereign tribal nation is its own category of government. A body spanning two towns is one body.**

## RULING 276 — the pilot ZIPs and the zip order

*`R-0276` · ACTIVE · author_explicit · 2026-09-03 · also cited as `RULING 276`, `R276`, `R-276`*

- **supersedes_full** → `R-X-the-zip-order-2026-08-20`

**Four pilot ZIPs: 85701 (Tucson AZ), 85641 (Vail AZ), 07866 (Rockaway Township NJ), 03255 (Newbury NH). Depth work runs NH → NJ → AZ 85641 → AZ 85701.** New Hampshire produces a draft; Rockaway Township is the median American shape and proves the method generalizes; Vail breaks it on the no-municipality edge; the New Jersey ballot-mailing window is the one external clock the author does not control. Pilot membership changes only by author decision. The depth order above governs only this commissioned four-pilot sweep; it orders no unrelated future session and sets no frontier sequence — the frontier is unordered.
